verdict.rationale: Model-file compatibility across runtime upgrades is a fair question for a local model runtime like Ollama, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of a model-file or quantization-format compatibility policy across upgrades. The API versioning note only covers HTTP API stability and deprecations, which is a different capability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether upgrading the runtime can break compatibility with previously downloaded quantized model files
